correctness.rationale: After positive diagonal similarity, the \(k\)-th iterate is \(q_k(C)c\). Exact expansion gives \(q_1(C)=\omega I\), \(q_2(C)=2\omega I-\omega^2C\), and the third-iterate off-diagonal identity with nonnegative path terms. Convergence implies \(0<\omega<2\) and \(q_3(C)\) is positive definite. This proves the universal direction. The two-by-two family \(C_a\) has \((q_3(C_a))_{12}=a\omega^2(3-2\omega)\), providing a convergent counterexample for every \(3/2<\omega<2\). Scalar convergence gives all-step positivity in dimension one. The exact witness is replayed by `verify.py`.

value.rationale: The weight parameter is central to weighted Jacobi convergence and parallel smoothing/preconditioning. A sharp universal boundary showing exactly how far one may overrelax while retaining the positive cone through the first three iterates separates two practically distinct properties—spectral convergence and order preservation. The dimension-two, iteration-three minimality and the all-weights sharp family make the claim structural rather than an isolated computation.
